info.title: Hurryline API
info.description: REST API for the Hurryline car-wash platform. Authentication uses Bearer JWT access tokens issued at login/register. The refresh token is stored in an httpOnly cookie and rotated via POST /api/v1/auth/refresh.

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token issued at login or register. Lifetime: 15 minutes.

CronSecret.name: x-cron-secret
CronSecret.description: Shared secret used by protected cron endpoints. Can be sent as x-cron-secret or Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>.

SuccessEnvelope.description: Standard success envelope. Status code is the primary success signal.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Standard error envelope. Status code is the primary error signal.

AuthUser.description: Authenticated user summary returned after login or register.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

Entry.description: A client entry - either a confirmed reservation or a walk-in queue entry.

post.summary: Authenticate a user
post.description: Validates credentials and returns a short-lived access token plus an httpOnly refresh token cookie. Rate-limited to prevent brute force attacks.

expected_role.description: Must match the authenticated user's actual role. Prevents cross-space token issuance.

remember_me.description: Extends the refresh token cookie lifetime.

403.description: Account not active or suspended

post.summary: Log out and revoke all refresh tokens
post.description: Clears the httpOnly refresh token cookie and revokes all refresh tokens for the user identified by the Bearer access token. The cookie is cleared unconditionally regardless of DB revocation outcome.
